inventory_status: candidate; membership and count differ between traditions

rules.text: a template matches only against SUPPLIED root radicals filling R1..R3 in order; no root is derived here
a matched row names degree, not identity: the intensive reading asserts habitual, professional or excessive performance and is never claimed for a single-occasion act
the closing taa of the فعالة row is declared intensifying, so this unit emits NO gender claim from it; gender is read from agreement elsewhere in the clause

the فعيل and فعول rows are declared shared with the quality-adjective inventory; the transitivity test (can an underlying verb with an object be recovered?) is SUPPLIED evidence and is not run by the consumer
the مفعال row is letter-identical to the instrument template and the فعلة row is letter-identical to a nominal template; both homographs are declared, so those skeletons abstain ambiguous_template
an annexed noun following an intensive form corresponds to the source verb's object; this unit flags the annexation for review and never re-analyses the clause
the six-row grouping is one of several competing traditions and the classical restriction to transitive triliteral verbs is recorded as unstated in the source; the inventory is candidate, not closed
